brief:
American activist Fergie Chambers defended himself in a Spanish court, characterizing Gaza as "the moral question of our time," Middle East Eye reported. The appearance marked his first courtroom defense since his detention in July, which followed a US extradition request.

Details of the charges against Chambers and the nature of the US extradition proceedings were not disclosed in the available reporting.

title: American activist tells Spanish court Gaza is moral question of our time
